items.en: Added `--marketplace <source>` to `claude plugin install`: adds the marketplace if needed, under the same policy checks as `claude plugin marketplace add`, then installs the plugin from it
items.zh: 为 `claude plugin install` 新增 `--marketplace <source>`：按需添加 marketplace，遵循与 `claude plugin marketplace add` 相同的策略检查，然后从中安装 plugin

items.en: Added an `effort` parameter to the Agent tool, so Claude runs a sub-agent at the effort level you ask for
items.zh: 为 Agent 工具新增 `effort` 参数，让 Claude 按你指定的 effort 级别运行 subagent

items.en: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_OVERLOADED_RETRY_BASE_DELAY_MS` environment variable to set a longer base delay for the backoff when retrying an overloaded (529) request
items.zh: 新增 `CLAUDE_CODE_OVERLOADED_RETRY_BASE_DELAY_MS` 环境变量，用于为重试过载（529）请求时的退避设置更长的基准延迟

items.en: Added `prompt.autocomplete`, an event a mod hooks to add its own rows to the prompt box's autocomplete list
items.zh: 新增 `prompt.autocomplete`，mod 可挂接此事件，向 prompt 框的自动补全列表添加自己的行

items.en: Added prompt caching to `$.model.complete` for mods: `prompt` and `system` take blocks of text, and `cache: true` on a block caches the request up to it
items.zh: 为 mod 的 `$.model.complete` 新增 prompt 缓存：`prompt` 和 `system` 接受文本块，块上的 `cache: true` 会缓存截至该块的请求

items.en: Added workflow agents to the `agent.spawn` mod hook, with their run and index, so a mod can refuse them
items.zh: 为 `agent.spawn` mod hook 新增 workflow agents，附带其运行和索引，使 mod 可以拒绝它们

items.en: \[Claude Tag] Added an Edit button to the Allowed domains card on a channel's Configure page, so Enterprise admins can open the access bundle that sets the channel's domains
items.zh: \[Claude Tag] 在频道 Configure 页面的 Allowed domains 卡片上新增 Edit 按钮，使 Enterprise 管理员可以打开设置该频道域名的访问包

items.en: \[Code Review] Added the period's total with its change from the previous period, and a breakdown by repository, to the PRs reviewed chart in Code Review analytics
items.zh: \[Code Review] 在 Code Review 分析中的 PRs reviewed 图表上新增该周期的总量及其较上一周期的变化，以及按仓库的细分

items.en: Changed local (stdio) MCP server connections to negotiate protocol version 2026-07-28 by default on every install, including Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry; `MCP_PROTOCOL_NEGOTIATION=legacy` opts out
items.zh: 变更本地（stdio）MCP 服务器连接：在每次安装时默认协商协议版本 2026-07-28，包括 Bedrock、Vertex 和 Foundry；`MCP_PROTOCOL_NEGOTIATION=legacy` 可退出此行为

items.en: Changed `claude plugin test`: a failed `expect` inside a hook the test registered, or a stub answer the engine refuses, now fails the test instead of passing silently
items.zh: 变更 `claude plugin test`：测试所注册的 hook 内 `expect` 失败，或引擎拒绝某个 stub 应答时，现在会使测试失败，而不是静默通过

items.en: Changed usage limit messages to write claude.ai settings links with https\:// so terminals and apps can make them clickable
items.zh: 变更用量限制消息：claude.ai 设置链接改用 https\:// 写出，以便终端和应用将其变为可点击链接

items.en: Changed scheduled and Run now routine runs to publish a new artifact only you can see without asking for approval; artifacts that request connectors or other access still ask
items.zh: 变更定时运行和 Run now 例程运行：发布的新 artifact 仅你自己可见，无需请求批准；请求 connector 或其他访问权限的 artifact 仍会请求批准

items.en: Changed agent names to allow at most 256 characters: a longer one is rejected, and a skill's or a plugin file's `name` longer than that is ignored
items.zh: 变更 agent 名称：最多允许 256 个字符，更长的名称会被拒绝；skill 或 plugin 文件中超过该长度的 `name` 会被忽略

items.en: \[Claude Tag] Changed the first message of a Slack thread continued with `!fork` to a card showing where it came from, the request, and who asked, with a link to the original thread
items.zh: \[Claude Tag] 变更用 `!fork` 延续的 Slack 线程的首条消息：改为一张卡片，显示其来源、请求内容以及发起人，并附原线程链接

items.en: \[Claude Tag] Changed the organization-wide and default spend limit boxes on Claude Tag's spend limits page in admin settings to save only when you press Save or Enter, not when you click away
items.zh: \[Claude Tag] 变更管理设置中 Claude Tag 用量限制页面上的组织级和默认支出上限输入框：仅在按 Save 或 Enter 时保存，点击别处不再保存

items.en: Improved startup of `claude -p` and SDK sessions: the first turn no longer waits for HTTP and SSE MCP servers to answer `resources/list`
items.zh: 改进 `claude -p` 和 SDK session 的启动：首轮不再等待 HTTP 和 SSE MCP 服务器响应 `resources/list`

items.en: Improved rendering speed of long bulleted or numbered replies: they stream, resize and re-open in the transcript (ctrl+o) much faster
items.zh: 改进长项目符号或编号回复的渲染速度：它们在对话记录（ctrl+o）中的流式输出、调整大小和重新打开都快得多

items.en: Improved Ctrl+C draft recovery: a cleared prompt now stays reachable with Up after a slash command or a sent message
items.zh: 改进 Ctrl+C 草稿恢复：在斜杠命令或已发送消息之后，被清空的 prompt 现在仍可通过 Up 找回

items.en: Improved hook output handling: `<system-reminder>` tags written in a hook's output are escaped before they reach Claude
items.zh: 改进 hook 输出处理：hook 输出中写入的 `<system-reminder>` 标签在到达 Claude 之前会被转义

items.en: Improved tool input handling: Grep accepts `file_path` for `path`, and Write, WebFetch and Read ignore a few stray parameters instead of failing the call
items.zh: 改进工具输入处理：Grep 接受用 `file_path` 作为 `path`，Write、WebFetch 和 Read 会忽略少量多余参数，而不是让调用失败

items.en: Improved the steps shown when a marketplace declared in a settings file has a name that looks like an official Anthropic marketplace
items.zh: 改进了当设置文件中声明的 marketplace 名称看起来像 Anthropic 官方 marketplace 时所显示的步骤

items.en: Improved sandbox auto-allow: with strict sandbox mode set in user, managed or --settings settings, an interpreter command with an env var prefix like `FOO=bar python3 app.py` runs unprompted
items.zh: 改进了沙箱自动允许：在用户、托管或 --settings 设置中启用严格沙箱模式后，带环境变量前缀的解释器命令（如 `FOO=bar python3 app.py`）无需提示即可运行

items.en: Improved the Artifact tool's listing: Claude now sees how many published artifacts you have and can list up to 200 at once instead of 50
items.zh: 改进了 Artifact 工具的列表功能：Claude 现在能看到你已发布的 artifact 数量，并且一次最多可列出 200 个，而不是 50 个

items.en: Improved cloud sessions after a restart: Claude is now told which stopped background agents it can resume by id
items.zh: 改进了重启后的云端 session：现在会告知 Claude 哪些已停止的后台 agent 可以按 id 恢复

items.en: Improved the Claude in Chrome message in claude.ai cloud sessions when the browser can't be reached: Claude is now told it may continue with alternatives if the user prefers
items.zh: 改进了 claude.ai 云端 session 中浏览器无法访问时显示的 Claude in Chrome 消息：现在会告知 Claude，如果用户愿意，可以继续使用替代方案

items.en: Improved the /focus tip: it now invites you to try focus view mid-turn and shows how to switch back
items.zh: 改进了 /focus 提示：现在会邀请你在回合进行中尝试专注视图，并说明如何切回

items.en: Improved startup with local (stdio) MCP servers that ignore the newer protocol check: after one slow connect they are remembered for 7 days and connected the older way without the wait
items.zh: 改进了与忽略较新协议检查的本地（stdio）MCP 服务器的启动：一次缓慢连接后，它们会被记住 7 天，并以旧方式连接，无需等待

items.en: \[Claude Tag] Improved `@Claude !status` in a channel to say when Claude has stopped reading its untagged messages, why, and that an @-mention starts it reading again
items.zh: \[Claude Tag] 改进了频道中的 `@Claude !status`：现在会说明 Claude 何时停止读取未标记的消息、原因，以及 @ 提及会使其重新开始读取

items.en: Fixed subagent definitions with `permissionMode: auto` entering auto mode when auto mode is unavailable (disabled by settings, circuit breaker, or a model that doesn't support it)
items.zh: 修复了带有 `permissionMode: auto` 的 subagent 定义在自动模式不可用时（被设置禁用、熔断器触发或模型不支持）仍进入自动模式的问题

items.en: Fixed sandboxed commands being able to read the staged file copies of `/ultrareview` uploads under `~/.claude/seed-admin`
items.zh: 修复了沙箱命令能够读取 `~/.claude/seed-admin` 下 `/ultrareview` 上传的暂存文件副本的问题

items.en: Fixed a managed sandbox read-deny path (and user ones beside it) that appears or re-points mid-session not dropping project grants inside it or ending credential injection from files it covers
items.zh: 修复了托管沙箱读取拒绝路径（以及旁边的用户路径）在 session 中途出现或重新指向时，未撤销其中的项目授权，或未终止其覆盖文件的凭据注入的问题

items.en: Fixed a notebook or PDF read on macOS and Windows being able to return a file outside what was approved, through a link swapped in mid-read
items.zh: 修复了在 macOS 和 Windows 上读取 notebook 或 PDF 时，通过读取中途替换的链接返回已批准范围之外文件的问题

items.en: Fixed a tampered on-disk cache of server-managed settings being able to switch off or unseat the built-in policy plugin while the settings fetch failed
items.zh: 修复了在设置获取失败期间，被篡改的服务器托管设置磁盘缓存能够关闭或替换内置策略 plugin 的问题

items.en: Fixed `rm -rf` on the 8.3 short name or another alternate Windows spelling of the home folder or a drive not being treated as removing it
items.zh: 修复了针对主目录或驱动器的 8.3 短名称或其他 Windows 替代拼写执行 `rm -rf` 时未被识别为删除该目录的问题

items.en: Security: Fixed PreToolUse hook approvals and auto mode bypassing the permission prompt for file reads from network (UNC) paths
items.zh: 安全：修复了 PreToolUse hook 批准和自动模式在从网络（UNC）路径读取文件时绕过权限提示的问题

items.en: Fixed a skill's or slash command's `allowed-tools` rule coming back in a later turn when you leave auto mode or plan mode partway through that turn
items.zh: 修复了在该回合中途退出自动模式或计划模式后，skill 或斜杠命令的 `allowed-tools` 规则在后续回合中重新生效的问题

items.en: Fixed `NO_PROXY` being ignored for Claude Code's own API requests (sign-in, policy, feedback, artifacts) when `HTTPS_PROXY` is set
items.zh: 修复了设置 `HTTPS_PROXY` 时，Claude Code 自身的 API 请求（登录、策略、反馈、artifacts）忽略 `NO_PROXY` 的问题

items.en: Fixed an MCP tool with a name longer than 128 characters making every request fail; that tool is now left out and an MCP error names it
items.zh: 修复了名称超过 128 个字符的 MCP 工具导致所有请求失败的问题；现在会排除该工具，并由 MCP 错误指明它

items.en: Fixed `claude plugin` commands such as `marketplace add` and `install` running before an organization's managed settings had loaded on a first run
items.zh: 修复了首次运行时，`claude plugin` 命令（如 `marketplace add` 和 `install`）在组织的托管设置加载完成之前就执行的问题

items.en: Fixed one-shot `claude -p` and Agent SDK runs stopping a background command 5 seconds after the final result, and one-shot `claude -p` runs dropping a scheduled wakeup; both are now waited for
items.zh: 修复了一次性 `claude -p` 和 Agent SDK 运行在最终结果后 5 秒停止后台命令，以及一次性 `claude -p` 运行丢弃已安排的唤醒的问题；现在两者都会等待完成

items.en: Fixed plan mode not being restored when resuming a session from the `claude --resume` session picker or with `/resume`
items.zh: 修复了通过 `claude --resume` session 选择器或使用 `/resume` 恢复 session 时，计划模式未被恢复的问题

items.en: Fixed saved scheduled tasks created after `/resume`, `/branch` or `/clear` never firing, and saved tasks ignoring later creates and deletes after two writes to the tasks file milliseconds apart
items.zh: 修复了在 `/resume`、`/branch` 或 `/clear` 之后创建的已保存定时任务从不触发的问题，以及在对任务文件相隔毫秒的两次写入之后，已保存任务忽略后续创建和删除的问题

items.en: Fixed a background session's `/loop` silently stopping when the session's process restarted (for example after a crash), because its pending wakeup was lost
items.zh: 修复了后台 session 的 `/loop` 在 session 进程重启时（例如崩溃后）静默停止的问题，原因是其待处理的唤醒丢失

items.en: Fixed Grep and Glob reporting no matches when the file or folder they were given could not be read; Claude now retries once or tells you
items.zh: 修复了 Grep 和 Glob 在无法读取所给文件或文件夹时报告无匹配的问题；Claude 现在会重试一次或告知你

items.en: Fixed the Read tool returning only the first entry, with no error, when a PDF's `pages` was a list such as "6,9,15"; it now returns an error saying to read each page or range separately
items.zh: 修复了当 PDF 的 `pages` 是诸如 "6,9,15" 的列表时，Read 工具仅返回第一个条目且不报错的问题；现在会返回错误，提示分别读取每一页或每个范围

items.en: Fixed @-mentioned text files over 256KB being left out silently: Claude is now told the file's size and to read it in portions
items.zh: 修复了超过 256KB 的 @ 提及文本文件被静默忽略的问题：现在会告知 Claude 该文件的大小，并要求分部分读取

items.en: Fixed the usage limit alert repeating once per background agent when agents failed on a limit that had already stopped the main conversation
items.zh: 修复了当 agents 因已停止主对话的用量限制而失败时，用量限制警报按每个后台 agent 重复一次的问题

items.en: Fixed Remote Control viewers seeing an empty subagent pane for background subagents in sessions hosted by the desktop app or an IDE
items.zh: 修复了 Remote Control 查看者在由桌面应用或 IDE 托管的 session 中，看到后台 subagents 的 subagent 窗格为空的问题

items.en: Fixed cross-session delivery notices showing two sessions with similar names as one recipient, and the expiry notice blaming the desktop app when a terminal session let the message lapse
items.zh: 修复了跨 session 投递通知将两个名称相似的 session 显示为同一接收方的问题，以及当终端 session 让消息过期时，过期通知错误归咎于桌面应用的问题

items.en: Fixed Send now in the desktop app ending the subagent a turn was waiting on when another message was already queued
items.zh: 修复了当另一条消息已排队时，桌面应用中的 Send now 结束了某一轮正在等待的 subagent 的问题

items.en: Fixed `/bug`, `/share` and `/feedback <text>` starting over after Ctrl+O or Ctrl+Z while a report was being sent, and closing as cancelled after it had been sent
items.zh: 修复了在报告发送过程中按 Ctrl+O 或 Ctrl+Z 后，`/bug`、`/share` 和 `/feedback <text>` 重新开始的问题，以及报告已发送后却以已取消状态关闭的问题

items.en: Fixed `/remote-env` replacing your saved default environment when you pressed Enter right away: the list now opens on your default, and no row has a check mark when no default is in effect
items.zh: 修复了立即按 Enter 时 `/remote-env` 替换已保存默认环境的问题：列表现在会打开在你的默认项上，且当没有生效的默认项时，任何行都不显示勾选标记

items.en: Fixed some pasted text reaching Claude as typed text when several pastes overlapped in one prompt
items.zh: 修复了当一个 prompt 中有多次粘贴重叠时，部分粘贴文本以键入文本形式到达 Claude 的问题

items.en: Fixed vim mode leaving the cursor past the end of a line, j/k losing their column on shorter lines, and `f`/`t`/`F`/`T`/`;`/`,` jumping to, or deleting up to, a match on another line of the prompt
items.zh: 修复了 vim 模式将光标留在行尾之后、j/k 在较短行上丢失列位置，以及 `f`/`t`/`F`/`T`/`;`/`,` 跳转到或删除到 prompt 另一行上的匹配项的问题

items.en: Fixed `/add-dir` path box letting Shift+Enter or a paste add a line break, and treating fast-typed "tab", "up" or "down" as those keys
items.zh: 修复了 `/add-dir` 路径框允许 Shift+Enter 或粘贴添加换行，以及将快速键入的 "tab"、"up" 或 "down" 当作对应按键的问题

items.en: Fixed fast typing, input-method text and decomposed accents being dropped while a prompt footer row was selected, and `!` leaving the row selected
items.zh: 修复了在选中 prompt 页脚行时快速键入、输入法文本和分解重音字符被丢弃的问题，以及 `!` 使该行保持选中状态的问题

items.en: Fixed fullscreen mode sending a full-screen clear on every window resize and Ctrl+L when iTerm2 is detected, which may be what filled iTerm2's scrollback with stale pages
items.zh: 修复了在检测到 iTerm2 时，全屏模式在每次窗口调整大小和 Ctrl+L 时发送全屏清除的问题，这可能正是 iTerm2 的滚动缓冲区被陈旧页面填满的原因

items.en: Fixed a spurious "could not be examined" note for @-words that name no file when a Read deny rule is set and the working directory is under a symlink
items.zh: 修复了在设置了 Read 拒绝规则且工作目录位于符号链接下时，对不指向任何文件的 @ 词条错误显示 "could not be examined" 提示的问题

items.en: Fixed "instruction file not loaded" lines going stale or missing after `/cd` or a permission change, and added a transcript line when a nested one isn't loaded
items.zh: 修复了在 `/cd` 或权限变更后 "instruction file not loaded" 行变得过时或缺失的问题，并在嵌套文件未加载时新增一行记录

items.en: Fixed a compaction summary that repeated `/name` letting Claude invoke a skill that is reserved for the user
items.zh: 修复了重复 `/name` 的上下文压缩摘要让 Claude 调用保留给用户的 skill 的问题

items.en: Fixed Write, Edit, NotebookEdit and LSP rows, and single Read, Grep and Glob rows, hiding why a mod denied the call: the row now shows the reason
items.zh: 修复 Write、Edit、NotebookEdit 和 LSP 行以及单条 Read、Grep 和 Glob 行隐藏 mod 拒绝调用原因的问题：现在该行会显示原因

items.en: Fixed a cloud session showing a turn that never ended when its worker was stopped just as the turn finished
items.zh: 修复云 session 在回合刚结束时其 worker 被停止、却显示一个永不结束的回合的问题

items.en: Fixed cloud sessions with a large transcript sometimes asking for a permission again after it was approved
items.zh: 修复 transcript 较大的云 session 有时在权限已获批准后再次请求权限的问题

items.en: Fixed scheduled tasks and other queued notifications being lost in cloud sessions when a message was retried or edited while Claude was reading them
items.zh: 修复在 Claude 读取消息时重试或编辑消息，导致定时任务和其他排队通知在云 session 中丢失的问题

items.en: Fixed cloud sessions forgetting the thinking setting chosen in the client when the session's container restarted
items.zh: 修复云 session 在容器重启后忘记客户端中所选 thinking 设置的问题

items.en: Fixed Cowork cloud sessions saying a proxy blocked artifacts when Anthropic couldn't confirm the organization's settings
items.zh: 修复 Cowork 云 session 在 Anthropic 无法确认组织设置时误报代理阻止了 artifact 的问题

items.en: Fixed plugins whose hooks module makes many `$.state` calls through one const taking minutes to load or validate
items.zh: 修复 hooks 模块通过一个 const 发起大量 `$.state` 调用的 plugin 加载或校验耗时数分钟的问题

items.en: Fixed `claude plugin validate` listing a matcher or state value for a hooks module that the engine reads from elsewhere
items.zh: 修复 `claude plugin validate` 为 hooks 模块列出引擎实际从别处读取的 matcher 或 state 值的问题

items.en: Fixed `claude plugin validate` listing a `$.state` value read through a top-level `var` that was declared again or reassigned; such a module is now refused
items.zh: 修复 `claude plugin validate` 列出通过顶层 `var` 读取的 `$.state` 值的问题，该 `var` 曾被重复声明或重新赋值；此类模块现在会被拒绝

items.en: Fixed a plugin's served `$` method restarting the hook origin, which could run a guard hook with a `.catch` above it again without end
items.zh: 修复 plugin 提供的 `$` 方法重启 hook 源的问题，该问题可能导致带有上方 `.catch` 的 guard hook 无休止地重复运行

items.en: Fixed plugin interface calls made while the plugin hooks worker restarts running without the hooks other plugins put on them
items.zh: 修复在 plugin hooks worker 重启期间发起的 plugin 接口调用未带上其他 plugin 附加的 hooks 就运行的问题

items.en: Fixed a mod's `config.set`, `state.set`, `env.set` or `agent.spawn` hook that denies after calling `next(e)` being answered as a refusal: the hook is now reported as failed, by name
items.zh: 修复 mod 的 `config.set`、`state.set`、`env.set` 或 `agent.spawn` hook 在调用 `next(e)` 后拒绝却被当作拒绝响应的问题：现在该 hook 会按名称报告为失败

items.en: Fixed `/theme`, the `/config` Theme menu and the first-run theme step saving a theme before a plugin's `config.set` hook was asked
items.zh: 修复 `/theme`、`/config` 的 Theme 菜单和首次运行的主题步骤在询问 plugin 的 `config.set` hook 之前就保存主题的问题

items.en: Fixed a plugin's `tool.check` hook answering allow running a tool that requires your answer (a question, a plan approval) without showing its dialog
items.zh: 修复 plugin 的 `tool.check` hook 返回 allow 时，未经显示对话框就运行需要你回答（提问、计划批准）的工具的问题

items.en: Fixed a mod's start-up prompt, command or subagent being queued a second time when the hooks worker was replaced
items.zh: 修复 hooks worker 被替换时 mod 的启动 prompt、命令或 subagent 被再次排队的问题

items.en: Fixed a mod's hook that called `next(e)` and then failed while the turn was interrupted letting the call through; the call is now rejected
items.zh: 修复 mod 的 hook 在调用 `next(e)` 后于回合中断期间失败却仍放行调用的问题；现在该调用会被拒绝

items.en: Fixed a plugin's prompt drop or setting deny being ignored when its reason was longer than 4,096 characters
items.zh: 修复 plugin 的 prompt 丢弃或设置拒绝在其原因超过 4,096 个字符时被忽略的问题

items.en: Fixed an organization's plugin being unloaded on its own reload, or after another plugin crashed, when it returned a `$` name that a user-installed mod had added; the mod is now unloaded instead
items.zh: 修复组织的 plugin 在自身重新加载时，或在另一个 plugin 崩溃后，因返回了用户安装的 mod 添加的 `$` 名称而被卸载的问题；现在改为卸载该 mod

items.en: Fixed tool calls made while the plugin hooks worker restarts being answered without the plugins' permission hooks
items.zh: 修复在 plugin hooks worker 重启期间发起的工具调用未经过 plugin 的权限 hooks 就被响应的问题

items.en: Fixed plugin `tool.call` hooks seeing some tool calls before misnamed parameters were repaired; a hook now sees the arguments the tool will run with
items.zh: 修复 plugin 的 `tool.call` hooks 在参数名错误被修复前就看到部分工具调用的问题；现在 hook 看到的是工具实际运行所用的参数

items.en: Fixed a mod's guard hook with a `.catch` being skipped silently for calls another mod's hook makes beneath the guard's own `$` call; its `.catch` is now asked
items.zh: 修复了某个 mod 的 guard hook 带有 `.catch` 时，另一个 mod 的 hook 在该 guard 自身的 `$` 调用之下发起的调用会被静默跳过的问题；现在会询问其 `.catch`

items.en: \[Cloud sessions] Fixed routine runs occasionally staying listed as running for hours after they had finished
items.zh: \[Cloud sessions] 修复了例程运行在完成后偶尔仍显示为运行中长达数小时的问题

items.en: \[Cloud sessions] Fixed editing or duplicating a routine turning off its push notifications when the routine had no saved notification setting
items.zh: \[Cloud sessions] 修复了在例程没有已保存的通知设置时，编辑或复制例程会关闭其推送通知的问题

items.en: \[Cloud sessions] Fixed SVG, HEIC, TIFF and other less common image files failing to attach; they now attach as regular files
items.zh: \[Cloud sessions] 修复了 SVG、HEIC、TIFF 及其他较少见的图片文件无法附加的问题；现在它们会作为普通文件附加

items.en: \[Cloud sessions] Fixed approval prompts offering "Always allow" for connector tools that an organization set to require approval; the choice had no effect
items.zh: \[Cloud sessions] 修复了审批提示为组织设置为需要审批的 connector 工具提供“始终允许”选项的问题；该选项此前没有效果

items.en: \[Remote Control] Fixed the first message of a new Remote Control session started from claude.ai/code accepting only images; it now accepts PDFs and other files like later messages
items.zh: \[Remote Control] 修复了从 claude.ai/code 启动的新 Remote Control session 的首条消息仅接受图片的问题；现在它像后续消息一样接受 PDF 和其他文件

items.en: \[Claude Tag] Fixed replies sent in a Slack thread while Claude was still on its first request there being held until that request finished, or missed when sent seconds apart
items.zh: \[Claude Tag] 修复了在 Slack 线程中发送的回复在 Claude 仍处理该线程首个请求时被搁置到该请求完成，或在相隔数秒发送时被遗漏的问题

items.en: \[Claude Tag] Fixed Slack threads woken only by GitHub pull request activity or a routine staying on their original model after an admin changed the channel or workspace default model
items.zh: \[Claude Tag] 修复了仅由 GitHub pull request 活动或例程唤醒的 Slack 线程在管理员更改频道或工作区默认模型后仍停留在原模型的问题

items.en: \[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude sometimes posting a spend limit notice in Slack when the real cause was that your organization had run out of usage credits
items.zh: \[Claude Tag] 修复了 Claude 有时在 Slack 中发布支出限制通知，而实际原因是你的组织用完了用量额度的问题

items.en: \[Claude Tag] Fixed a session hanging until interrupted when a permission prompt that can't be answered from Slack was denied automatically
items.zh: \[Claude Tag] 修复了无法从 Slack 回答的权限提示被自动拒绝时，session 挂起直到被中断的问题

items.en: \[Code Review] Fixed a queued review failing when the pull request moved to a new base branch and the old one was deleted; the commit is now re-queued for review
items.zh: \[Code Review] 修复了 pull request 切换到新的基础分支且旧分支被删除时，排队的审查失败的问题；现在该提交会重新排队等待审查

items.en: \[Code Review] Fixed reviews ignoring a CLAUDE.md's rules when the pull request edits that file; reviews now use its version from the base branch
items.zh: \[Code Review] 修复了 pull request 编辑 CLAUDE.md 时审查忽略其规则的问题；现在审查会使用基础分支中的版本

summary.tldr: 新增插件安装指定市场、Agent effort 参数与多项安全修复，MCP 协议默认升级。

highlights.title: 插件安装支持指定市场
highlights.detail: claude plugin install 新增 --marketplace，可按需添加市场并沿用相同策略检查后安装插件。

highlights.title: Agent 工具新增 effort 参数
highlights.detail: 可指定 subagent 运行的 effort 级别，便于按任务复杂度控制投入。

highlights.title: 本地 MCP 默认新协议
highlights.detail: stdio MCP 服务器连接默认协商 2026-07-28 协议版本，旧服务器可能受影响。
highlights.action: 若本地 MCP 服务器不兼容，设置 MCP_PROTOCOL_NEGOTIATION=legacy 退回旧行为。

highlights.title: UNC 路径权限绕过修复
highlights.detail: 修复从网络（UNC）路径读取文件时 PreToolUse hook 批准与自动模式绕过权限提示的问题。

highlights.title: 沙箱与符号链接越权修复
highlights.detail: 修复沙箱读取暂存文件、托管沙箱路径重定向及 macOS/Windows 读取中途替换链接导致越权访问的问题。

highlights.title: 插件测试失败不再静默通过
highlights.detail: claude plugin test 中 hook 的 expect 失败或引擎拒绝 stub 应答时现在会报错，便于及早发现问题。
